{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit mock-neck sweater, slim fit, hip length, long sleeves, cobalt blue (#2F4FA3), extra-fine merino wool

A-line midi skirt, mid-calf length with soft pleats at the waist, deep plum (#5A2A55), textured jacquard crepe

Sheer tights, 20 denier, black (#1A1A1A), matte nylon

Ankle boots, pointed toe, 6 cm block heel, black (#17171C), smooth leather

Tailored single-breasted coat, knee length, charcoal (#2B2D33), dense wool with a soft finish

Drop earrings, medium length, silver (#C0C0C8), polished metal

Structured mini clutch with a short chain strap, cobalt blue (#2F4FA3), satin-finish leather

Why this outfit works: The saturated cobalt and deep plum make a bold color pairing that stands out in the warm artificial light of the theatre, which is what you asked for. Cobalt echoes your blue eyes and looks striking against your silver hair and fair skin. The refined knit with a midi skirt and ankle boots keeps the look neat and polished for an evening performance. The neutral charcoal coat keeps the autumn evening comfortable and lets the colors show once you step inside."}
